newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex details Mexico's Campeche offshore reserves.
newsitem.headline: Pemex details Mexico's Campeche offshore reserves.

text.p: State oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos on Monday gave a new detailed breakdown of crude and natural gas reserves in its northeast and southwest offshore production regions in Campeche Sound, compiled according to international standards and independently audited.

Pemex said it would release new data for its South and North production regions in 1998 and 1999 respectively, and would meanwhile continue to issue reserves data using its traditional methodology for the next three years alongside the new data.
According to traditional Pemex methodology, proven reserves in the Campeche offshore region as of January 1, 1996 were 28.71 billion barrels of crude equivalent.
According to the new methodology, total proven reserves in the same region as of January 1, 1997 were 17.1 billion barrels of crude equivalent.
The different methodologies were not compatible, Pemex said.
